veg-vegetable-pad-thai.title: Vegetable Pad Thai
veg-vegetable-pad-thai.author: avlxyz
veg-vegetable-pad-thai.description: Pad Thai Vegetarian - Spicy Noodle AUD8 --- Half the train network was badly affected by the crazy winds in Melbourne, so instead of spending hours waiting for a train, we decided to have dinner in the city and try our luck later. We headed to Spicy Noodle for some spicy food to warm us up. I decided to have the Bun Bo Hue which I had wanted to try since they added a new Vietnamese menu to their range of Thai food, so I had the Bun Bo Hue. And the verdict? Not that great, and a bit strange to have an oil slick floating on top. I had to scoop most of the oil off onto the llittle dish underneath. I'll stick to their Thai food, I think. Oh, and I had to take a photo of Julia's Pad Thai to compare to the Pad Thai I had the previous week. Same? Similar :) In the end, it took us around 1.5 hrs to get home, not too bad considering we had to take a train to Oakleigh, and change to a bus. Spicy Noodle Cafe 198 Latrobe St Melbourne 3000 (03) 9639 7677 Photos: - Pad Thai Vegetarian - Julia's - Pad Thai Vegetarian - from the previous week - Bun Bo Hue - other Pad Thai photos
